For usage instructions follow [openai/whisper-large-v3](https://huggingface.co/openai/whisper-large-v3).

Large-v3 finetune trained as a baseline with smaller checkpoints in progress. Expecting worse long form and equal short form.

[Benchmarks](BENCH.md). Has occasional repetition issue compared to previous models but achieves competitive/SOTA CER across all tested sets.

# Acknowledgements

* Train sets: OOPPEENN, Reazon, 小虫哥_, Common Voice 20, deepghs
* Test sets: KitsuneX07, TEDxJP, kotoba-tech, Saruwatari-lab, grider-withourai
